about: ThrusterChain lesson data. Keys as in the lesson spec (env, learn, new: pruned copies of the facts files, same paths, full precision). Load with the port's use(): it restores {_cols,_data} tables, {_f64,_shape} base64 float64 arrays and {_e6} millionths, and rebuilds the _derived tables.

splits.evaluation: episodes 700-999, 30,000 rows (held out, never trained on)

settings_thrusterchain.observation_normalization: (o - mean) / (std + 0.001) over the kept training rows

derived.lambda_identity: All rewards are negative, so every Q1 is negative and -lambda * mean Q1 = alpha exactly (lambda = alpha / mean|Q1|). The value term always adds alpha to the loss level; only its slope (gradient) steers the actor.

examples.scores_rule: np.abs(np.random.default_rng(20261015).standard_normal(19)): the absolute values of 19 standard normal numbers (an illustrative |N(0, 1)| sample, not ThrusterChain data)

laws.density: p_xi(c) = exp(xi c) / M(xi) on [0.1, 1.1], M(xi) = (exp(1.1 xi) - exp(0.1 xi)) / xi

small_example.rule: illustration with a stated model, not ThrusterChain data: currents c_j from the training law (xi = -2) by inverse CDF of default_rng([20261015, 3]).uniform(40); critic errors e_j = (0.05 + 0.25 c_j) z_j with z_j standard normal (the same generator, next 40 draws); scale 1, so each score is |e_j| in value units and the threshold is the band's half-width. The error-size model is the page's own assumption for its coverage chart (#weighting-test, 'Coverage at test as the shift grows').

harm_checks.stop: the pre-registered rule stopped the test before any BCA run (12 Oct 2026, 20:39 UTC)

stage2_seeds_0_4.claim_sentence: In strong current, BCA's lower edge recovers 39.2 of 98.9 points and keeps 119% of TD3+BC's gain over cloning in the recorded conditions. A hand-set limit to the recorded range recovers 107.4. In the no-stall world, where the missing commands help, BCA costs 14.8 points and the range limit 30.9.

findings: 1. No shift: coverage 91.2% (medium-replay) to 92.5% (medium-expert), inside the required 89-94%; width tracks error (rank correlation 0.10-0.33, lower bounds above 0).
2. Strong test: unweighted coverage 83.3% (expert) to 86.7% (random); exact weights restore 91.0% to 94.6% (mild test 90.7%-93.1%); estimated weights within 0.1-0.8 points of exact.

3. Steps whose command lies in the removed region: both weighted bands refuse 100% (by construction, they were given the region), 0% outside; the unweighted band covers worse inside on 3 of the 4 judged qualities (fails on medium-expert).
4. Return: not testable under the pre-registered rules (no quality passed both checks before training).
Exploratory A: plain TD3+BC's two-critic band q ± |Q1 − Q2| covers 38.7%-46.7% with no shift.
Exploratory B: BCA's training runs: weighting changes return by −2.07 to +0.01 points (capped pull) and −0.08 to +0.21 (lower edge); no gain.
Exploratory D: at the actor's own commands past 80% the band covers 48% (medium-expert) and 25% (expert): it is honest where calibrated, not where the lower edge reads it.

Exploratory F: band weighted for the actor's own commands, fixed fallback: +2.0 points (medium-expert, +25.0 return units) and +5.8 points (expert, +74.2 units) on the strong test, every seed positive; untargeted control about +1 unit; estimated weights +2.3 points on expert only.
